title: Thick cylinder under internal pressure (Lame)
description: Steel tube, inner radius a = 50 mm, outer radius b = 2a = 100 mm, 20 mm long, 100 MPa inside. Quarter model: x = 0 and y = 0 are symmetry planes and the end z = 0 slides; the other end is free (open ends, no axial stress). Probes on the y = 0 plane, where the x displacement is the radial one and the y stress is the hoop stress.
description_check: The description gives b = 2a but not a, the pressure or the end condition. a and the pressure only scale the answers. The end condition changes the radial displacement (open ends, plane strain or closed ends) but not the hoop stress; open ends were modelled because the Lame solution is then exact in 3D.

quantities.label: Radial displacement at the bore
quantities.citation: Timoshenko & Goodier, Theory of Elasticity, 3rd ed., McGraw-Hill 1970, Section 28, section to be checked
quantities.tolerance_reason: With open ends the Lame solution is exact in 3D (axial stress zero, axial strain uniform), and displacements converge fastest, so only the mesh error remains.
